subject: Request: operator access validation, MFA session slices & bridge letter (SOC 2 Type II)
messages:
From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 follow-up: operator access validation, scoped session slices, and bridge letter

Hannah —

Thanks again for the SOC 2 Type II report you uploaded. Our audit team (Ethan from AuditPartner is copied) is running a targeted risk review and needs a few items to close the access-control workstream:

- Bridge letter confirming continuity of controls from your 2027 report period through 2028-03-31.
- A small set of MFA/session slices for operator/service-account activity for the audit window 2027-11-01 to 2028-02-28. We only need traces where authentication events resulted in privileged token issuance (service operator role) — approx 50–200 rows. CSV is fine.
- A short narrative confirming whether emergency/standby operator accounts are in scope and how they are provisioned/deprovisioned.

Could you confirm scope and an estimated delivery date? If you have a form or process we should use for the extract request, point me to it.

Appreciate your help — we’re trying to avoid a second-round request.

Best,
Priya Shah
Senior IT Auditor
Novamed

[attachment: novamed-request-form.pdf (pdf)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Ethan Rhodes <er@auditpartner.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: operator access validation, scoped session slices, and bridge letter

Priya —

Thanks for the clear ask. We can provide all three items but need to confirm a small number of parameters so we extract the correct slices:

1) Operator definition: We assume by "operator/service-account" you mean identities with the internal role label "operator" (role_id: OPERATOR) and any service principal bound to the "ops-tier" policies. Confirm?
2) Sample size: you asked for ~50–200 rows. We typically deliver a CSV with the event rows and a separate mapping file for identity IDs -> human-readable names. Is that acceptable?
3) Time window: 2027-11-01 to 2028-02-28 — confirming this is the audit window you want (we can expand if needed).
4) Redaction: will you need any PII redacted from those CSVs (we can hash emails/ids)?

Planned next steps (proposed):
- Kar, can you prepare a scoped export with the following: auth events where role=OPERATOR OR policy contains ops-tier, auth result, MFA factor, token_issued boolean, timestamp, source_ip. Include identity mapping. Output CSV + small extract query doc.
- I'll draft the bridge letter and attach the SOC 2 Type II PDF.

Target delivery: I can send the bridge letter and initial extracts by Fri 2028-03-24 EOD PT if Kar confirms the query. If you need the extract earlier, please let us know.

Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

[attachment: redwood-soc2-type2-2027.zip (pdf)]

From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Mar 2028 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: operator access validation, scoped session slices, and bridge letter

Hannah / Laura —

I can run the extract. Notes on implementation and what I will deliver:
- Query: auth_events where (role_id = 'OPERATOR' OR policy_tags LIKE '%ops-tier%') AND timestamp >= '2027-11-01' AND timestamp <= '2028-02-28' AND token_issued = true.
- Fields: timestamp, identity_id, identity_type (human/service), auth_method, mfa_used, token_type, source_ip, session_duration_seconds, request_id.
- Deliverables: (1) raw CSV (mfa-session-sample-queries.csv) with identity_id hashed for PII; (2) mapping csv with identity_id -> canonical alias (hashed) and account_type; (3) extraction notes (SQL used).
- Expected rows: ~120 (estimate from sampling).
- ETA: I can have the files ready by Fri 2028-03-24 17:00 PT. If auditors need fewer rows, I can truncate.

Flagging one item for policy/narrative: emergency/standby operator accounts are created by the on-call runbook (svc-account provisioning) and require two-person approval (ticketing), and we deprovision via the offboarding runbook within 24 hours of ticket closure. I will include the runbook links and ticketing proof references in the extract notes.

-Kar
Karthik Iyer
Sr. Infrastructure Engineer (Security Automation)
Redwood Inference

[attachment: mfa-session-sample-queries.csv (csv)]

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novamed.com>, Ethan Rhodes <er@auditpartner.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 23 Mar 2028 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 follow-up: operator access validation, scoped session slices, and bridge letter

Priya / Ethan —

Attached is the bridge letter (redwood-bridge-letter-2028-03-23.pdf), the SOC 2 Type II PDF, and a scoped CSV extract (mfa-session-sample-queries.csv) with identity hashes. Summary:

- Bridge letter: confirms no material control changes since the 2027 report period and identifies the 2028 control owners.
- Scoped extract: ~118 rows covering OPERATOR role and ops-tier service principals, includes mfa_used and token_issued flags. Identity values are salted hashes to meet PII constraints; mapping file is available under NDA if you require de-anonymization.
- Emergency operator handling: created via the runbook (link included) with two-person approval; deprovisioning occurs within 24 hours of ticket closure.

If you want the raw mapping file (identity->email) we need a signed minimal NDA / data processing addendum. Otherwise the salted hashes should be sufficient for control verification.

Deliverables attached: redwood-bridge-letter-2028-03-23.pdf, soc2-type2-report-2027.pdf, mfa-session-sample-queries.csv

Let me know if auditors need any additional fields (e.g., full request/response logs).

Regards,
Hannah Schmitt
Manager, Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
